title: Smt. Uma Rani Urf Aisleen vs Rohit Chand on 12 August, 2021

paragraphs.text:
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
 
 

?Court No. - 43
 

 
Case :- TRANSFER APPLICATION (CIVIL) No. - 19 of 2020
 

 
Applicant :- Smt. Uma Rani Urf Aisleen
 
Opposite Party :- Rohit Chand
 
Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutosh Kumar Pandey,Shiv Sharan Tripathi
 
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Ganesh Shankar Patel,Sanjay Srivastava
 

 
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.

In re: Civil Misc. Restoration Application No. 6 of 2021 
 
This is an application for recall of the order dated 22.07.2021, whereby the transfer application was dismissed for non prosecution. The application is supported with an affidavit.

The grounds shown in the affidavit for non-appearance of learned counsel for the applicant on 22.07.2021 is sufficient. This application is allowed. The order dated 22.07.2021 is recalled. The transfer application is restored to its original number.
Heard Sri Ashutosh Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ganesh Shankar Patel, learned counsel for the respondent.

This is a transfer application filed by the applicant-wife seeking transfer of a Divorce Petition No. 152 of 2018 ( Rohit Chandra Vs. Smt. Uma Rani @ Aisleen ), under Section 10 (I) (IX, X) of the Indian Divorce Act, 1869 filed by the husband at Badaun. Its transfer is being sought to District Aligarh on the ground of convenience.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has filed a Complaint Case No. 1934 of 2018 ( Uma Rani Vs. Rohit Chandra and others ), under Sections 498A , 323 , 504 , 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P.Act and in the said case the opposite party has been summoned and the said case is pending consideration before the court of Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate, Aligarh. She has filed a Complaint Case No. 1789 of 2018 ( Uma Rani Vs. Rohit Chandra and others ) under Sections 12 , 19 , 21 , 22 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 and the same is pending consideration before the Court of Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate-II, Aligarh. She instituted a proceeding under Section 125 Cr.P.C. for maintenance being Case No. 1004 of 2018 ( Smt. Uma Rani Vs. Rohit Chandra ) and the same is pending before the Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Aligarh.

In the counter affidavit filed by Sri Ganesh Shankar Patel, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent, the pendency of the cases before the competent courts at Aligarh has not been disputed.
In my considered opinion, all cases between the parties are better heard and decided at district Aligarh for the sake of convenience of all concerned.

For this reason alone, this transfer application is liable to be allowed and is allowed. The Divorce Petition No. 152 of 2018 ( Rohit Chandra Vs. Smt. Uma Rani @ Aisleen ) pending before the Principal Judge, Family Court, Badaun stand transferred to Aligarh forthwith.
